cases.situation: Plumber was booked for 8am to fix our leaking water heater. I took the morning off, it's 10 now and nobody showed or called. The company is Apex Plumbing, the scheduler was Tina.
cases.reply: Hi Tina, Apex was booked for 8am today to repair the water heater at 45 Linden St, and nobody arrived or called. I took the morning off for this. Can you confirm a new time by end of day tomorrow? If I don't hear back by then, I'll book another plumber.
cases.note: Factual and dated, with the consequence stated once, not threatened.

cases.situation: 闺蜜最近三次约饭都是当天下午才说来不了，这周六又约了看展。我不想闹僵，但真的有点累了。
cases.reply: 我很喜欢跟你出来玩，但最近三次约好的饭都是当天取消的，我这边就有点不敢提前安排了。不是生气，就是想找个对你更轻松的方式。周六要不改成下午在你家附近喝杯咖啡？或者你说说什么安排更适合你。
cases.note: 用"三次"而不是"你总是"，对方就没法争论；说的是你会怎么调整，不是给她下通牒。

cases.situation: I completely forgot a 9am discovery call with a potential client, Amanda, who runs a group of dental clinics. She just emailed 'Did I have the wrong time?' I'm a freelance web designer.
cases.reply: Hi Amanda, you had the right time. I missed our 9am call and I'm sorry, you set aside the start of your morning and I wasn't there. Could we do Thursday at 9 or Friday at 1? I'll bring a first-pass review of your online booking page so the time is well spent.
cases.note: Take the blame off her first, then offer two slots so she doesn't do the rescheduling work.

cases.situation: I'm a private math tutor. A parent, Mrs. Alvarez, cancelled her son's session 2 hours before the start, second time this month. My policy, which she signed, is 24 hours' notice or the full $60 is charged. She just texted that charging for a cancellation is ridiculous.
cases.reply: Hi Mrs. Alvarez, I understand it's frustrating, especially in a busy week. The 24-hour policy is in the agreement you signed in September, and I apply it to every family, so today's $60 charge stands. I'd like to keep Mateo's momentum going before his unit test: I have Thursday at 5pm or Saturday at 10am open this week. Which suits you better?
cases.note: When a client argues the fee: restate the policy once, apply it evenly, and move straight to rebooking. Waiving it for the loudest parent teaches everyone else.
